entry.title: 2026-11-15 — clarification, no version change
entry.summary: The capability count is stated the same way on every page: four capabilities — find, act, confirm, recover — and two cross-cutting checks, admit and disclose. This edition already published both checks as cross-cutting; three pages counted them inconsistently. The front page listed admit as a fifth row in the capability table, the capabilities page named only disclose in its introduction, and the scope page said "one cross-cutting check". No job, level or grade changes.

entry.title: 2026-11-14 — Tare Shopfront Standard v1.0
entry.summary: The first public edition. It publishes, as one document set: The 22 hotel shopfront jobs across four families — 7 find, 5 act, 5 confirm, 5 recover — each with what the surface must expose, the evidence class that settles it, and the anchor it borrows its shape from. The ladder — Level 1 findable through Level 5 delegable — with the rule that the level is the last link that works end to end, and the grade A–F printed beside it and never alone.
